Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 4, Verse 24

“The offering is Brahman, the oblation is Brahman, poured by Brahman into the fire of Brahman. Brahman is reached by one absorbed in Brahman as action.”

A famous verse in which every element of the ritual collapses into a single reality. The chant-like repetition enacts what it describes — no separate parts left anywhere.
